{{Top|leg}}
A '''grand council''' was the governmental body that ruled each [[Gree (species)/Legends|Gree]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] within the [[Gree Enclave/Legends|Gree Enclave]]. Each planet had a council, which was made up of representatives from each [[guild council]]. They met when needed, and were ultimately answerable to the [[grandmaster council]] based on the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], [[Gree/Legends|Gree]].
